title: Comprehensive Evaluation of Visual Function
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to assess the level of visual functioning in patients with various eye conditions while wearing different types of eyeglasses.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Have normal vision
* Are far-sighted or near-sighted
* Have no eye diseases Subjects aged 18 and over, who have refractive errors ranging from +5.0 to -5.0 and/or who have eye disease will be included in the study.
